_note: SYNTH demo signals for the Disruption Sensing monitor. Fictional; not real events.

signals.raw_text: [DEMO] Armed attack reported on a container vessel near the Bab el-Mandeb strait. Several carriers are rerouting Europe-India services via the Cape of Good Hope; the route remains open but war-risk premiums have risen.
[DEMO] Severe cyclone warning for the Tamil Nadu coast. Vessel movements at Chennai port suspended for the next 4 days.
[DEMO] Customs notice: import duty on bulk drug (API) consignments of Chinese origin to rise by 50% from next month.
[DEMO] Berth congestion at JNPT / Nhava Sheva: container vessels waiting 6 days on average.
[DEMO] Strait of Malacca closed to commercial traffic after a multi-vessel collision; closure expected to last 10 days.
[DEMO] Local football league postpones weekend fixtures due to heavy rain.
